dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp-edged white horizontal bars alternating with dark feather bodies on visible folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, roughly circular rufous-colored patch on the posterior crown and upper nape.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and gradual color transition with low linearity between the crown and mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bold white and dark-brown/black transverse banding on the remiges and rectrices contrasting with the solid-colored upperparts.
